title: Settlement classes and judicial approval
summary: A settlement class seeks certification for resolving a controversy by an agreed compromise rather than through a class trial. Certification requirements and review of the settlement’s fairness remain distinct safeguards.
notes: A beneficial compromise does not by itself create an adequately represented or cohesive class. Amchem and Ortiz examine different certification categories and should retain their separate tests.

sections.Meaning: A settlement class seeks certification for resolving a controversy by an agreed compromise rather than through a class trial. Certification requirements and review of the settlement’s fairness remain distinct safeguards.
sections.How to work through the question: Apply Rule 23(a) and the relevant Rule 23(b) category, identifying any conflicts and need for subclasses. Then evaluate the settlement under the applicable approval procedure. Explain which manageability concerns disappear because no trial is planned and which protections remain.
